MIND. [1] [Alum.]
Consciousness of his personal identity confused. θ Paralysis.
Great weakness or loss of memory.
Inability to recollect things or follow up a train of thought. θ Cephalalgia.
Confusion and obscuration of intellect ; met. θ Spinal disease.
Time passes too slowly ; intolerable ennui ; an hour seems half a day.
Seeing blood on a knife, she has horrid ideas of killing herself, though she abhors the idea.
No desire to do anything, especially anything serious. θ Cephalalgia.
Depressed and lachrymose. θ Melancholia.
Low-spirited, trifling things appeared insurmountable. θ Liver complaint.
Apprehensive of losing his reason.
Anguish, oppressive and vague fearfulness, or uneasiness, as if he had committed a crime. θ Cephalalgia.
Variable mood, at one time confident, at another timid.
Disposition quiet and resigned ; met. θ Spinal disease.
Peevish and whining, with hot earlobes.
Mental symptoms worse in morning on awaking.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Alum.]
Vertigo : everything turns in a circle ; with nausea ; < before breakfast ; on opening eyes ; on stooping ; > after breakfast, and from wiping eyes ; nausea, faintness, pain in nape of neck ; as if drunken ; with seeing white stars ; when closing eyes.
Stupefaction, with dread of falling forward.
Inability to walk, except with eyes open, and in daytime. θ Locomotor ataxia.
Cloudiness and drunken feeling, alternating with pain in kidneys.
When his eyes were closed, his whole body tottered ; if not firmly held, he fell to ground ; met. θ Spinal disease.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Alum.]
Headache : from chronic catarrhs of head ; with constipation ; > by lying quiet in bed, or resting head upon a cushion.
Heaviness of head, with pale, languid face ; vertex painful to touch.
Headache in region of both parietal bones. θ Spinal disease.
Increased pulsation of temporal arteries. θ Spinal disease.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Alum.]
Headache, as if hair was pulled ; with nausea.
Falling off and excessive dryness of hair ; scalp sore when hair is touched ; creeping and titillation of scalp.
Pain in head and nape of neck < on going to bed ; leaves on rising in morning.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Alum.]
Vision dim and eyes dry in evening. θ Chronic catarrh.
Seeing fiery spots ; met. θ Spinal disease.
Dim-sightedness, like looking through a fog, or as if feathers were before eyes ; must rub eyes.
Burning and pressure in eyes.
Red eyes with lachrymation.
Eyes inflamed, itching at inner canthus ; agglutination at night, and lachrymation by day ; yellow halo around candle ; burning and dryness, smarting, but with very little ulceration.
Spasmodic closure of lids at night, and burning in eyes in morning and evening. θ Ophthalmia.
Strabismus of either eye ; especially from loss of power of internal rectus.
Pressure in eyes, which are sensitive to light.
Eyelids thickened, dry, burning.
Chronic granular lids.
Upper lids seem to hang down as if paralyzed, especially left. θ Old, dry granular lids.
Burning and dryness in lids every evening, with pain in internal canthus of left eye, with much dry mucus in morning on waking.
Burning, dryness ; burning on waking, especially on looking up, with dread of light.
Itching in canthi with burning.
Tottering and falling when closing eyes ; met. θ Spinal disease.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Alum.]
Buzzing as if outside ear.
Redness and heat of one ear ; evenings.
Stitches in ears, evening or night.
Purulent otorrhœa.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Alum.]
Sense of smell weak.
Nose stopped up, more left side, with glairy mucus.
Chronic nasal catarrh, with scurfy sore nostrils, and discharge of thick yellow mucus.
Catarrhs of long standing with old people.
Discharge of dry, hard, yellow-green mucus from nose ; nose swollen, red and sore to touch, worse in evening.
Nose dry ; met. θ Spinal disease.
Violent pain in root of nose. θ Ozæna.
Copious, yellow, sour-smelling mucus, with sore nostrils.
Septum narium swollen, red and painful to touch ; more painful evenings.
Redness of nose.
Nose ulcerated.
Swelling and hardness of left alæ nasi.
Point of nose cracked.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Alum.]
Tension of skin of face, as though white of egg had dried on it.
Tetter on temples and forearm. θ Leucorrhœa.
Heat and redness ; met. θ Spinal disease.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Alum.]
Involuntary spasmodic twitching of lower jaw, with hemorrhage of bowels ; dark, offensive stools.
Trismus.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Alum.]
Teeth feel long and sore.
Toothache ; teeth feel loose and elongated, < from chewing, in open air, evening.
Drawing toothache, extending to other parts, as down larynx, neck or shoulders. θ During pregnancy.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Alum.]
Taste flat ; met. θ Spinal disease.
Tongue coated with a thin slimy fur ; met. θ Spinal disease.
Taste : acrid, sweetish or fatty ; almost lost ; like blood.
Tingling, itching on tongue, must scratch it. θ During pregnancy.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Alum.]
Musty, bad odor from mouth.
Small ulcers in mouth.
Saliva increased, although mouth may feel dry.
Increased saliva and mucus.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Alum.]
Inflammatory redness in back of throat.
Transient stitches in throat.
Dryness of throat, as if parched.
Rawness and roughness in throat, inducing hawking or coughing in evening, with secretion of mucus.
Pressure in throat as from a plug, with soreness and dryness.
Sense of constriction from pharynx down to stomach, as if food could not pass.
Great dryness of throat especially on awaking, voice husky ; constant hawking, and sensation of a lump in throat. θ Chronic catarrh.
Feeling of a splinter in throat, stinging on swallowing.
Thick mucus, dropping from posterior nares.
Ulcers in fauces, spongy ; secreting a yellowish-brown, badly smelling pus ; with boring pains from fauces to right temple and head.
Throat feels relaxed.
Feels food whole length of œsophagus.
Swallowing painful, > after warm drinks ; swallowing saliva or liquids often > ; swallows solids with difficulty.
Violent pressive pain, as if a portion of œsophagus was contracted or compressed, in middle of chest, especially during deglutition, but also when not swallowing, with oppression of chest, alternately with palpitation of heart, especially after a meal.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Alum.]
No desire to eat.
Has no appetite, food has no taste.
Irregular appetite.
Longing for fruit and vegetables ; potatoes disagree.
Aversion to meat ; to beer ; meat has no taste.
Appetite for starch, chalk ; clean white rags ; charcoal, cloves, acids, coffee or tea-grounds, dry rice, and other indigestible things. θ Chlorosis.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Alum.]
Worse from eating potatoes. θ Colic. θ Indigestion.
All irritating things, like salt, wine, vinegar, pepper, etc., immediately start cough.
Easily drunken from weakest spirituous drinks.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Alum.]
Eructations : sour ; bitter, after potatoes ; < evenings.
Vomiting of food, mucus or bile ; met. θ Spinal disease.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Alum.]
Constriction and twisting in stomach, extending up œsophagus to throat.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Alum.]
Pains in epigastrium and hypochondria when stooping.
Contractions in both hypochonders.
Liver pains, as if bruised, when stooping ; stitches when rising again.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Alum.]
Pressing in both groins, towards sexual organs, evenings.
Stitching, pressing pain in region of abdominal ring, like from hernia, with tension as far as side of abdomen.
Painters' colic.
Soreness and twitching of right inguinal glands.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Alum.]
Inactivity of rectum ; even soft stool requires great straining.
No desire for, and no ability to pass stool, until there is a large accumulation.
Severe hemorrhage from bowels with flow of urine. θ Typhoid.
Tenesmus in rectum and bladder at same time. θ Proctitis.
Stools : hard and knotty or covered with mucus ; like sheep's dung, with cutting in anus, followed by blood ; like pipe stems.
Constipation from great dryness of mucous follicles of rectum, with long-lasting pain in rectum.
Diarrhœa, urging in rectum, bloody, scanty stools.
Clots of blood pass from anus.
Dropping of blood during an evacuation.
Itching and burning at anus.
Soft and thin stool, passing with difficulty.
Chronic diarrhœa ; < on alternate days ; from walking ; > from a short sleep or warm applications.
Diarrhœa whenever she urinates.
Chronic diarrhœa. θ Chlorosis.
Blind piles protrude, become moist, with lancinating pain ; are hard and itch.
During stool : rectum as if constricted and dried up ; throbbing in small of back ; excoriated feeling in rectum ; chills all over ; discharge of prostatic juice.
Varices become moist, sting and burn.
Itching with burning excoriation and great sensitiveness. θ Hemorrhoids.
Fistula ani.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Alum.]
Frequent micturition. θ Prolapsus uteri.
Tenesmus vesicæ. θ Dysentery.
Urine voided while straining at stool ; or cannot pass urine without such straining.
Urine red without sediment ; met. θ Spinal disease.
Urine smarting, corroding. θ Prolapsus uteri.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Alum.]
Excessive sexual desire.
Frequent and painful erections, < at night.
Involuntary emissions, followed by all his old symptoms.
Sexual desire lessened. θ Impotence.
Feeling of weakness in bladder and genitals ; he fears he will wet the bed.
Discharge of prostatic fluid during difficult stool.
Pressure in perineum at beginning of an erection or during coitus.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Alum.]
Prolapsus uteri.
Bland, painless ulcers upon os. θ Prolapsus uteri.
Severe painful swelling in either or both ovaries, very sensitive to touch. θ Metritis.
During an evacuation before menses, she has pinching, writhing and pressing like labor-pains.
Menses scanty, pale and painful. θ Prolapsus uteri.
After menses : exhausted in body and mind. θ Leucorrhœa.
Leucorrhœa : of transparent mucus, attended with tremor and sensation as if everything would fall out of abdomen ; acrid, corrosive ; profuse, relieved by cold washing ; during day ; with tetter on temples ; corroding, profuse, running down to heels, often only in daytime, relieved by cold washes.
Free light yellow excoriating discharge from vagina.
Itching and burning pimples on labia.
Inflammation and swelling of vagina.
Stitches, throbbing and itching in vagina. θ Prolapsus uteri.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Alum.]
Gastric and abdominal symptoms during pregnancy : heartburn ; constipation from inactive rectum ; groaning at night, crying out "it is not I," begging them to stop ; tongue tingles ; mucous leucorrhœa, which runs down limbs.
Constipation of sucklings.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Alum.]
Voice hoarse, rough, hollow, almost aphonic ; met. θ Spinal disease.
Tickling in larynx, with irritation to cough.
   

COUGH. [27] [Alum.]
Dry, hacking cough, with frequent sneezing.
Cough : from sensation as of loose skin hanging in throat ; from tickling in larynx ; from elongated uvula ; from talking or singing ; short ; causes pains in right temple and top of head, sometimes also difficult breathing ; soon after waking in morning ; every morning a long attack of dry cough, ending in difficult raising of a little white mucus ; with tearing pain and involuntary emission of urine, in old or withered looking people ; sudden, violent irrepressible cough in evening while sitting ; sometimes yields a piece of mucus mixed with blood ; causes shooting in vertex.
Dry cough at night, with dryness of throat.
Continued dry hacking cough, with vomiting and arrest of breathing.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Alum.]
Talking increases soreness of chest ; lifting aggravates or produces soreness in left chest.
When stooping, a stitch from left side of abdomen to middle of chest.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Alum.]
Palpitation of heart. θ Prolapsus uteri. θ Dysphagia.
Palpitation irregular, large and small beats intermixed.
Pulse hard, 90 to 100 ; met. θ Spinal disease.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Alum.]
Shooting in right side of neck, posterior portion.
Pain in back, as if a hot iron was thrust through lower vertebræ.
Cervical muscles drew head back during sleep ; met. θ Spinal disease.
Violent stitch in middle of back.
Gnawing pain in back.
Pain in sacrum. θ Uterine troubles.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Alum.]
Tetter on forearm. θ Leucorrhœa.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Alum.]
Long continued tension in thighs and legs, almost like a cramp, extending downward.
Nates go to sleep when sitting.
Great heaviness in lower limbs, can scarcely drag them ; when walking he staggers, and must sit down ; evenings.
Frequent cramps in calves.
Trembling of knees.
Numbness of heel when stepping.
Pain in sole of foot, on stepping, as though it were too soft and swollen. θ Tabes dorsalis.
Heaviness in feet with great lassitude of legs.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Alum.]
Arms and legs feel heavy.
Pains in limbs as if bones were squeezed narrower, with pressure in joints.
Drawing in extremities.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Alum.]
Raising head : increases vertigo, nausea and vomiting ; met. θ Spinal disease.
When attempting to walk, great weakness and uncertainty in lower limbs, has to be led ; met. θ Spinal disease.
When walking : abdomen hangs heavily ; discharge of dark blood from rectum ; fluor albus more profuse.
   

NERVES. [36] [Alum.]
Much fatigued by talking.
Faint and tired, must sit down.
Involuntary movements of single parts.
Spasms, with attacks of laughing and weeping.
Paralysis from spinal disease ; cannot walk with eyes closed.
Hysteria. θ Prolapsus uteri.
Tremor. θ Leucorrhœa and prolapsus.
Slow tottering gait, as after severe illness.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Alum.]
Sleepiness, with inclination to lie down.
Unrefreshing night sleep ; a mere slumbering, with feeling in morning as if he had not slept enough. θ Cephalalgia.
 with many dreams and frequent awaking ; starts in affright ; muttering or crying.
Restless sleep, always awaking with palpitation of heart.
During sleep cervical muscles drew head backward ; met. θ Spinal disease.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Alum.]
She feels better in open air. θ Prolapsus uteri.
Worse in dry weather ; thin fecal stools.
   

FEVER. [40] [Alum.]
Chill appeared after eating soup at dinner. θ Intermittent.
Slight chill in evening ; met. θ Spinal disease.
   

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Alum.]
Worse at new and full moon. θ Skin symptoms.
Worse in winter. θ Skin symptoms.
Worse on alternate days. θ Chronic diarrhœa. θ Chlorosis. θ Prolapsus uteri.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Alum.]
Chlorosis.
Scrofula.
   

SKIN. [46] [Alum.]
Skin yellow. θ Liver complaint.
Intolerable itching of whole body, especially when getting warm in bed ; scratches until skin bleeds, which is then painful.
Leprosy.
Dry, tettery, itching eruption.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Alum.]
Cholera infantum, stools green ; acidity of primæ viæ.
Chronic catarrh of head.
